summary: Solid structure with good modular separation and error handling, but requires polish. Critical gaps: (1) Module lacks Set-StrictMode (best practice); (2) Property existence checks in Get-SecretStatus (lines 30–37) use truthiness (-not $Secret.Name) instead of explicit null/empty checks, risking silent failures with edge-case JSON payloads; (3) RequiredBy join in Format-RotationReport line 97 assumes array without null-guard; (4) Workflow assertion step (line 60) is logically correct but error message is confusing (says 'it reported' when intent is clearer as 'outcome not failure'). Fixture files and test files are absent but outside scope per instructions. No Set-StrictMode, and parameter validation could be more defensive.
